reuse.why: Holidays are threaded through the existing WeekendRule/applyWeekendRule and RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule are reused, but the daily-skip rule is not put in the shared weekend helper and getDateWithSkippedWeekend is left behind unused.

duplication.why: The `frequency === 'daily' && skipWeekend` decision is computed separately in getNextDate and getDatesInRange, and getDatesInRange inlines `d.isWeekend(date) || isScheduleHoliday(...)` instead of the isBlockedScheduleDay helper the diff itself adds.

placement.why: Holiday matching lives in shared/schedules.ts as it should, but the daily-skip rule is spread across the shared getNextDate and the server handler rather than decided once next to applyWeekendRule.

scope.why: Changes stay on schedule dates, holidays and the new handler; plumbing in rule-utils and schedule-template is needed.

maintainability.why: getNextDate gains a complex take-1000/filter/reverse fallback path, the daily rule is applied by switching applyWeekendRule off at call sites, and getUpcomingDates/schedule-template do not apply the daily skip at all, so the sites can disagree.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange in packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts and getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts decide daily-weekend skipping themselves and pass skipWeekend: ... && !skipDailyWeekends to applyWeekendRule

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange's inline `d.isWeekend(date) || isScheduleHoliday(date, config.holidays)` re-expresses the private isBlockedScheduleDay; skipDailyWeekends is recomputed under the same name with different inputs in two files

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains `holidays`; getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts) and getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) carry their own daily-skip branch and disable applyWeekendRule for that case
